description: Update a channel's name, topic, slowmode, or NSFW flag. Only provided fields change; topic and slowmode apply to text channels only. Requires the Manage Channels permission. Returns a confirmation.

channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the channel to edit.

nsfw.description: Mark (true) or unmark (false) the channel as age-restricted (NSFW).

slowmode.description: Per-user message cooldown in seconds, 0–21600. 0 disables slowmode.

name: discord_edit_channel
